I grow maize on my main plot and I managed to get fertilizer and seed coupons through the FISP program this year. I will spread the two bags of fertilizer across this plot and my smaller piece of land, which should give the maize a good amount of nutrient. My family will do most of the ridging, planting, and weeding, but I will hire a few days of ganyu when the work is heavy. We depend entirely on the rains here in Mangochi, so I will not irrigate, and I do not use chemicals for pests on food crops like maize.
